description: Read the Unified Component Model (UCM) digital twin of one datasheet already extracted with DatasheetVend. Every fact comes with a check ('passed', 'needs_review', 'disagrees', 'failed_sanity_check') and, where the extraction recorded one, its datasheet page, filed where it belongs: pins, whole_part (temperatures, absolute limits, package, ordering code), interfaces_rails (I2C/SPI/clock/ADC requirements and supply-rail values), registers (the register map) and checks. Call it first with no options for the summary, then ask for `sections`, one `pin` (by number, name or alternate function) or a `search` term so the answer stays small. Treat facts that did not pass as unverified and cite their page. Reads stored results only: never extracts, never bills. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; find datasheet names with datasheetvend_list_component_twins. To twin a datasheet the account has not extracted, use datasheetvend_build_component_twin.

datasheet.description: The datasheet name exactly as datasheetvend_list_component_twins returns it. A unique part of the name also works.

max_facts.description: Cap on facts returned across the pin and sections (default 200). `truncated` says when it was reached.

only_passed.description: Only facts that passed every check. Default false: every fact comes with its check.

pin.description: One pin by number, name or alternate function (for example '27', 'PC4' or 'SDA'): every fact that reaches it — its own and those of its rails and interfaces.

search.description: Only facts whose parameter, symbol, statement or node contains this text, case-insensitive (for example 'storage temperature' or 'TWCR'). With no sections given, searches pins, whole_part, interfaces_rails and registers.

sections.description: Parts of the twin to include besides the summary: pins (each pin's own facts), whole_part, interfaces_rails, registers, checks (disagreements, failed sanity checks, facts to review, facts that name no pin). Omit for the summary only.

name: datasheetvend_get_component_twin

modules.description: Module ids combined into this twin

runs.description: Extraction runs the twin draws on

disagreements.description: Parameters holding more than one value

pin.description: The requested pin with the facts that reach it, or null when no pin was asked for.

sections.description: The requested sections: pins, whole_part, interfaces_rails, registers, checks — facts with their check and, where recorded, their page.

title: Read a datasheet's component twin
